00013|   itself and every ``"job.term.<something>"`` such as ``"job.term.failed"`` and
00014|   ``"job.term.skipped"``, but not the unrelated ``"job.started"``.
00015| 
00016| Delivery is synchronous, in-process, and ordered: every published event gets a
00017| monotonically increasing sequence number, and handlers for a topic fire in the

00021| from __future__ import annotations

00023| from taskflow.model import Event

00028| 
00029|     A topic matches a prefix when it equals the prefix exactly or when it is a
00030|     dotted descendant of it. The trailing dot is required so that the prefix
00031|     ``"job"`` matches ``"job.started"`` but not an unrelated ``"jobless"``.
00032|     """

00040|     __slots__ = ("bus", "kind", "key", "handler", "active")

00062| class EventBus:
00063|     """A synchronous, deterministic publish/subscribe bus.
00064| 
00065|     Exact subscribers are stored per topic; prefix subscribers are stored in a
00066|     flat, insertion-ordered list and consulted on every publish. Each publish
00067|     stamps the event with the next sequence number and the supplied virtual
00068|     time, then delivers it -- first to the exact subscribers of its topic, then
00069|     to every matching prefix subscriber -- in subscription order.
00070|     """
00071|

00074|         self._prefix = []

00083|         Returns a :class:`Subscription`. The same handler may subscribe to
00084|         several topics; each call yields its own cancellable handle.
00085|         """

00095|         dotted subtree rooted at ``prefix`` (see :func:`_prefix_matches`).
